question: Which of the following alterations in amino acid metabolism is caused by a deficit of vitamin B12 ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Vitamin B12 deficiency -> Impaired conversion of methylmalonyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA -> Methyl-malonic acidemia -> 95% CHAIN: Vitamin B12 deficiency -> Impaired conversion of phenylalanine to tyrosine -> Phenylketonuric hyperphenylalaninemia -> 90% CHAIN: Vitamin B12 deficiency -> Impaired conversion of tyrosine to fumarate -> Hypertirosinemia type I -> 85% CHAIN: Vitamin B12 deficiency -> Impaired conversion of homogentisic acid to maleylacetoacetic acid -> Alcaptonuria -> 95%
